audit.CS38_requires: Explicit codec negotiation/version/backend plus supported FPGA decoder/credit/reference recovery path; byte budget alone cannot add these.
audit.extra_runtime_byte: Reject oversize/truncated datagram length beyond allowed1064B.
audit.boot_scratch_scope: ensure_core programming block before session buffer exists; not added as simultaneous runtime DMA.
audit.stack_scope: Separate persistent task stack declaration, not measured maximum stack use or DMA buffer.
audit.memory_scope: Not total ESP32 SRAM: Wi-Fi/lwIP/socket queues, SDK/SPI descriptors or bounce buffers, other tasks/heap and actual state layout remain unmeasured.
audit.clock_scope: Driver chooses first declared rate<=requested maximum; actual pin clock/divider/stalls not measured.

nominal_clean_success_MMIO.scope: Identity(two reads)+credit read per forward; clean ready begin and commit only. These phase/SDK costs remain in the unknown allowance, not subtracted twice.

audit.blocking_task: recv_from→parse/bitwiseCRC→begin-if-SOF→Device::try_lock/identity+credit→blocking spi_write→stats→commit/reply-if-EOF→yield_now; lock busy or credit failure drops/aborts.
audit.fragmentation_scope: Canonical host default full1024B payloads except tail; receiver also accepts smaller sequential fragments, which increase overhead.
audit.source_crc_scope: 8 source-level bit rounds per payload byte, not compiled instructions/cycles.
audit.protocol_scope: Sequential/no reordering queue; valid in-order successful frames assumed. Failure recovery, socket wait and contention/drop rates unmeasured.

assumptions.default_reserve_scope: 0 is only maximum residual envelope; other FPGA/decode/display/host stages are NOT measured or free.5/10ms are explicit hypothetical reserves.
assumptions.RF_scope: L3IPv4UDPdata bytes only; no802.11/MAC/PHY/ACK/retries/FEC/security overhead, link contention, input/audio/feedback traffic or RFgoodput measurement.
assumptions.feedback_scope: Current32Bfeedback+28BIPv4UDP per successful frame is an additional reverse-path minimum14400bit/s at30, plus heartbeat/input/error messages; excluded from data-only figures.
assumptions.pipeline_scope: Blocking app task can coexist with OS network ingress; no measured scheduling/queue/drop/decode/presentation model. FPGA/currentJPEG decode+publication must get real measured budget.

scope: 457 actual retainedCS38 complete bytecounts are carried hypothetically through currentMSV1-sized fragments; currentfirmware/FPGA remainJPEG-only and cannotrunthiscodec.
HEADER40 appliesonlynetwork; firmware stripsit beforeQSPI. Hypothetical16/8Bheaders changeL3costonly here and benefitALLcodecs; noimplementedlayout/negotiation/CPUgain claimed.
All arithmetic is exact rational where time is fractional. Every assumed-overhead deadline miss is retained, including negative margins.
Residualbudget is maxAMORTIZED combinedunmodeled successful-frame time perfragment afterQSPIphaselowerbound/reserve; not per-callmeasuredCPU, sustainedRF, memoryfit, or end-to-endFPS proof.
